g.text: The scalar field is discretely valued; the fixed field C remains discrete. DD5–DD6.

text.style: font-size: 19px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #172b4d

g.text: No discrete datum has a finite chart norming boundary.

text.style: font-size: 16px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #172b4d

g.text: A finite family of nontrivial restrictions to C has a common small element.

text.style: font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #172b4d

g.text: Hence the chart completion has no Noetherian ring of definition. DD7.
